== frame after_cat cursor=8,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo first > f.txt
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo second >> f.txt
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat f.txt
|first
|second
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame after_stdin cursor=12,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo first > f.txt
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo second >> f.txt
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat f.txt
|first
|second
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat < f.txt
|first
|second
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@12 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== effect f.txt
|first
|second
